knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Introduction

This is an example R Markdown post. When you run `Rscript render.R`, this file will be converted to a Jekyll-compatible markdown file in `_posts/`.

## Example: Basic R Output

```{r}
summary(mtcars)
```

## Example: A Plot

```{r example-plot}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, y = hp, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Miles per Gallon vs Horsepower",
    x = "MPG",
    y = "Horsepower",
    color = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## How to Use

1. Create your `.Rmd` file in `_knitr/` with the naming convention `YYYY-MM-DD-post-title.Rmd`
2. Run `cd _knitr && Rscript render.R` to generate the markdown
3. The output `.md` file will appear in `_posts/`
4. Any figures will be saved to `assets/images/knitr/YYYY-MM-DD-post-title/`

## Notes

- Delete this example file once you've confirmed the workflow works
- The underscore prefix (`_example`) prevents Jekyll from processing this as a post directly
